market_summary: Markets across FX, Gold, US100, and BTC are experiencing mid-session consolidation or mean-reversion pullbacks after earlier directional expansions. XAUUSD remains in a strong downside trend under negative GEX dampening near key support. US100 rejected Call Wall #1 in a positive GEX dampening regime, prompting a pullback toward Gamma Flip. EURUSD, GBPUSD, and BTCUSD are consolidating within value areas or pulling back on fading CVD pressure. All symbols present insufficient high-confluence entry criteria, resulting in a full HOLD batch.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (4027.30) and below POC (4044.57) during NEW_YORK_SESSION. CVD is -3.30 (BEARISH) with negative slope (-0.73), fully aligning with downward momentum. Price is extension testing below the lower ATR band (3991.63), well below VWAP (4034.42) and EMA50 (4021.41). GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING below Gamma Flip (3999.25), accelerating downside flushes. Current bar is sweeping Session Low (3984.52) without strong volume spike (RVOL 0.66), suggesting potential overextension into support/Put Wall #2 at 3873.86. Rejection/flush dynamics favor short continuation on minor pullbacks, but current stretch at lower ATR band warrants caution.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below VWAP and EMA50 baseline

signals.rationale: Price is trading inside VA (VAL 1.10824 to VAH 1.11455) near POC (1.10920) during NEW_YORK_SESSION. CVD is -14,869 (BEARISH) with negative slope, supporting overall trend weakness. However, price is consolidating mid-channel near EMA20 (1.10966) and slightly above VAL/Session Low support after a strong down move. VWAP (1.11250) and EMA50 (1.11149) sit well above. RVOL is low (0.543), indicating a lack of immediate directional volume. Given the price resting near POC inside value, mean reversion chop dominates.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below VWAP and EMA50 baseline

signals.rationale: Price is inside VA (VAL 1.32661 to VAH 1.33233), below POC (1.32813) in NEW_YORK_SESSION. CVD is -2,081 (NEUTRAL) with low RVOL (0.246), indicating consolidation after the prior downtrend. Price is holding just above Session Low (1.32661) and below EMA20 (1.32810), EMA50 (1.32982), and VWAP (1.33064). With low volume and neutral order flow within the value area, there is no high-probability breakout setup.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below VWAP and EMA50 baseline

signals.rationale: Price is above VAH (28343.60) and well above POC (28267.73) in NEW_YORK_SESSION. CVD is +13.19 (BULLISH) confirming upward structure. Price is well above VWAP (28209.94) and EMA50 (28317.92). GEX regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING (price 28457.17 above Gamma Flip 28446.94). Under positive GEX, price rejected cleanly off Call Wall #1 (28550.03) near Session High (28596.50) and is pulling back toward Gamma Flip/EMA20 (28454.74). US100 tick volume does not print RVOL > 2.0, but positive dampening GEX regime implies dealer selling near Call Wall #1, favoring a pullback rather than direct continuation.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish above VWAP and EMA50 baseline

signals.rationale: Price is above VAH (73998.28) and POC (73660.42) during NEW_YORK_SESSION. VWAP (73789.24) and EMA50 (73958.18) are sloped upwards, providing solid structural support. However, CVD is -0.07 (BEARISH) showing bearish divergence against the recent price peak. After touching upper ATR band near Session High (74706.2), price pulled back to trade near EMA20 (74157.42) and S/R (74085.2). RVOL is low (0.694) without a breakout volume spike. Divergent CVD and lack of volume confirmation warrant waiting for a cleaner retest of support.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish above VWAP and EMA50 baseline
